🌀 Storm names 2026 official hurricane name lists

When a tropical storm or hurricane forms it receives the next unused name from the official WMO list for its basin. The lists rotate every 6 years, so 2026 reuses the 2020 lists (with retired names replaced). Names active right now are highlighted.

Western Pacific typhoons use a separate 140-name roster shared by 14 countries — not listed here. Sources: NOAA NHC · World Meteorological Organization (WMO)
